arguments.code:
from datetime import datetime

# login
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']

target_year = datetime.now().year

# fetch all recommendations (paginated)
recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    recs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

# evaluate classical + released in target year
selected=[]
for r in recs:
    sid=r['song_id']
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date=s.get('release_date')
    genre=s.get('genre')
    release_year=None
    if isinstance(release_date,str) and len(release_date)>=4:
        try:
            release_year=int(release_date[:4])
        except:
            release_year=None
    # classical check (prefer song genre)
    is_classical = (genre=='classical')
    if is_classical and release_year==target_year:
        selected.append(sid)

print('target_year', target_year)
print('recommendations_total', len(recs))
print('selected_count', len(selected))
print('selected_song_ids', selected)

# show details of selected songs
for sid in selected:
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    print('---', sid, s.get('title'), 'genre', s.get('genre'), 'release_date', s.get('release_date'))

from datetime import datetime

# login
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']

# create new playlist
playlist_title = 'Spotify Recommended Songs'
create_resp = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title=playlist_title, access_token=access_token, is_public=False)
print('create_resp', create_resp)
playlist_id = create_resp['playlist_id']

# target songs computed earlier (classical released this year)
target_year = datetime.now().year
selected_song_ids = [265, 273]
print('playlist_id', playlist_id)
print('target_year', target_year)
print('selected_song_ids', selected_song_ids)

# add songs
add_results=[]
for sid in selected_song_ids:
    r = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
    add_results.append((sid, r))
print('add_results', add_results)

# verify by fetching playlist
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=access_token)
print('playlist songs count', len(pl.get('songs', [])))
print('playlist song ids', [s['id'] for s in pl.get('songs', [])])
